text_block_list.text:
On our way home from the Japan Cup,
Mihono
Bourbon speaks up after a long
bout of silence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I would like to run in even
bigger races.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It may shock you, but my reasoning is
emotional.
choice_data_list: Where did that come from all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have learned many emotions during the
Twinkle
Series, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The one that I felt today was the
deepest and
most striking.

She closes her eyes, as if recalling the
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was a warm, exhilarating sensation
that welled
up from the depths of my
heart—I believe it was
"pride."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I believe it was due to the size of the
venue and
the heated competition I
faced from Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the more powerful my

competition, the more "emotions" I will
be able
to...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, there is more to be gained from
racing than
that.

She seems unsure, yet confident at the
same time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This concept, it makes me "happy." This
is why I
want to run in bigger races.

For better or worse, Mihono Bourbon
isn't the
type to assert herself.

With the exception of aiming for her
long-held
dream of winning the Classic
Triple Crown, she's
pretty much only
followed orders.

Now she's thinking for herself and boldly
stating
that she wants to run in bigger
races!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Please respond.

Hearing this, Mihono Bourbon nods
happily.
choice_data_list: Let's enter a bigger race next time!

text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is waiting for us in front of
the
dormitory when we get back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon! Good job at the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I went to cheer you on from
the stands
when I heard you would be
running against Teio.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Thank you very much. That
makes
me "happy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No... I should be the one thanking you.
Seeing
you race inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I noticed something while I was
watching. It's like
something in you has
changed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, I realized this too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So it's true, then... I had a feeling that
was the
case. I'm happy for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, actually...
Rice Shower's expression turns serious.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't waiting here just to tell you that.

Actually... I wanted to tell you that I'm
planning
to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's a huge race that McQueen and Teio
will be
running in as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, um... If you don't mind, could you
challenge
me again there?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We've both improved ourselves since the
last
time we raced, so I want to race you
again as I am
now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not just you I want to pit myself
against...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to race against the
new-and-improved
versions of Teio,
McQueen, and everyone on a
big stage!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It'll be such an exciting race! I just know
it!

The Rice Shower who stands before us
smiling so
brightly looks like an entirely
different person
than before. Her usual
timidity is nowhere to be
found.

It seems like she has grown a lot over
the course
of the Twinkle Series.
And so has Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, Tokai Teio, and Rice
Shower...

Her eyes glitter with excitement for what
awaits
her in the future.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I wish to run in the Arima Kinen.

We decide that our next target is the
Arima
Kinen, a G1 race where only the
best runners
gather!
